statusDetail: Coverage-complete audit of four representative public templates plus an HTTP failure state. Excludes the separate secure.loteriadehoy.com account origin and exhaustive lottery-template duplication.

page.notes: Public Spanish lottery-results and gambling-information site. Raw HTML contains 99% of rendered content.

artifacts.caption: Homepage under dark, reduced-motion and increased-contrast preferences
Platform, semantics, focus and CSS feature probe
Metadata, link, form, media and PWA probe
Computed styles and animations under user preferences
Routes, headings, robots and sitemap recon

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshot and computed-style probe under prefers-color-scheme: dark
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark preference matched, but body remained rgb(255,255,255), color-scheme was normal, and the preference screenshot was identical to light mode.
The preference matched and document.getAnimations() returned no active animations, so there was no non-essential motion to suppress.

checkOutcomes.method: prefers-contrast probe plus Lighthouse contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page did not expose contrast-specific styling and Lighthouse found multiple WCAG contrast failures, including teal buttons at 2.95:1.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS/DOM platform probe and route walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The multi-page navigation has no view-transition-name or View Transition CSS; route changes are abrupt full-document swaps.
No parallax, scrollytelling, entry reveal, carousel, or other scroll-linked motion exists on the representative pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: No parallax, scrollytelling, entry reveal, carousel, or other scroll-linked motion exists on the representative pages.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM interaction inspection on menu and FAQ
checkOutcomes.evidence: Interactions use native links and buttons; no custom pointermove, swipe, or pull gesture was exposed in the representative paths.
On pages up to 22,963 CSS px tall, the chrome provides no scroll progress or position-aware cue; the platform probe found no scroll-state/timeline styling.
No tooltip, popover, or viewport-edge menu requiring anchored positioning appeared in the representative paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, or viewport-edge menu requiring anchored positioning appeared in the representative paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Navigation swaps abruptly and the very long results page lacks progress, current-section, or other attention cues.
No modal, consent wall, or interstitial obscured primary content on load; advertising occupied bounded page regions.

checkOutcomes.method: FAQ interaction and DOM semantics inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The FAQ disclosure uses no details elements; after one interaction all sampled question buttons reported aria-expanded=true, making state semantics unreliable.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile visual review and layout metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: The results template is 22,963 CSS px tall and adds a persistent right rail of logos plus repeated social controls and advertising around the result content.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout primitives at 360x800 on four templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: All four layouts reported scrollWidth 360, innerWidth 360, viewport meta present, and zero horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop/mobile screenshot comparison and narrow layout metrics
checkOutcomes.evidence: Hero actions change from a row on desktop to a stacked mobile layout, while result/detail/help templates fit at 360 px without overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatic focus/target probe and Lighthouse accessibility audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Many links expose outline:none when focused, result buttons are 38 px tall, and hundreds of empty hash links add unnamed keyboard stops.
The home page clearly offers result categories, and result/detail/help pages state their purpose with prominent headings and actions.

checkOutcomes.method: Direct navigation through home, listing, and Lotto Activo detail URLs
checkOutcomes.evidence: The core information journey is reachable without login: home links to results, results expose dated outcomes, and a lottery detail explains schedules.
A missing route returns a bare Apache 404 with no site navigation, search, home link, or recovery action.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse plus DevTools trace and layout observer
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace LCP was 973 ms and TBT 6 ms, but Lighthouse measured CLS 0.265, outside the good range.
Lighthouse measured CLS 0.265; all 100 result-page images and all 33 home images lacked explicit width/height.
The trace recorded one 56.25 ms long task and only 6.25 ms total blocking time over a 5.8 s capture.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against DOM assets and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: The results page made 205 requests, loaded 173 images, and shipped seven parser-inserted high-priority stylesheets; 88 below-fold images were eager.
Lighthouse estimated 85 KiB unused JS and 37 KiB unused CSS, including 95% of Bootstrap CSS and 86% of datatables.js.
All 100 result images lacked alt, 310 of 409 links had no text, Lighthouse found unnamed links, and the date input had no label.
Lighthouse found repeated failures: primary teal buttons at 2.95:1, orange Register at 2.47:1, and heading teal at 2.8:1.

checkOutcomes.method: Heading/focus probe and Lighthouse accessibility audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage jumps from H5 to H1 to H6, Lighthouse flags heading order, and many focusable links have no visible outline or accessible name.
Body text wraps within the viewport with readable line lengths and no clipping on the sampled templates.

checkOutcomes.method: 360 px reflow, viewport, and target-size inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Reflow itself succeeds and scaling is allowed, but prominent result controls are only 38 px tall and dense unnamed icon links create poor touch/keyboard targets.
Lighthouse reported no browser errors logged to the console.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, image primitive, and Lighthouse asset audits
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and UTF-8 are valid, but 100/100 result images lack dimensions and Lighthouse flags a low-resolution ad asset.
The page is excluded from BFCache by cache-control:no-store and Lighthouse recorded DevTools cookie issues.

checkOutcomes.method: Metadata probe across home and result templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Descriptions exist, but titles are keyword-stuffed: 1,073 characters on the results page and similarly excessive on home, rather than concise unique descriptions.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM link probe, robots fetch, and Lighthouse SEO
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport and robots are valid, but 312 of 409 result links use href="#" and 310 links have empty text, undermining crawlable descriptive navigation.
Pages return 200 and allow search indexing, but no canonical is present and /sitemap.xml returns an Apache 404.
No JSON-LD exists; og:url and og:image are malformed with a single slash, and the generic keyword-stuffed og:title does not accurately summarize the result page.
HTTPS is used, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent; PHPSESSID is neither Secure nor HttpOnly and has SameSite=None.

checkOutcomes.method: Trackers, cookies, secrets, and HAR primitives
checkOutcomes.evidence: Seven third-party origins include Analytics and DoubleClick; analytics cookies last 400 days and 213,552 transferred bytes were third-party. No exposed secret was found.
No permission prompt or authentication form appeared on the audited public pages; authentication is hosted on a separate secure subdomain outside this run.
checkOutcomes.reason: No permission prompt or authentication form appeared on the audited public pages; authentication is hosted on a separate secure subdomain outside this run.

checkOutcomes.evidence: X-Frame-Options is present, but HSTS, CSP/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent, while cookies use SameSite=None.
Raw HTML preserves 99% of rendered content on home and results, including title, H1 and description; neither page is a JS shell.

checkOutcomes.method: FAQ interaction and responsive visual inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Layouts remain in bounds, but FAQ disclosure state is inconsistent: all sampled questions report aria-expanded=true after one question is activated.
This is a server-rendered lottery-results content site rather than an installed app; no manifest or controlling service worker exists, and installability is not needed for the core task.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a server-rendered lottery-results content site rather than an installed app; no manifest or controlling service worker exists, and installability is not needed for the core task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative HTTP failure state is a bare server 404 with no branded explanation, navigation, or retry/home recovery.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language and visual reading-order inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The document declares lang="es" and the Spanish left-to-right content reads and lays out correctly on all sampled pages.
Dates are rendered in natural Spanish, for example “17 de julio de 2026”, rather than an ambiguous numeric-only format.
The site shows local Venezuelan daily draw schedules and dates, with no cross-time-zone events, user-entered times, or DST-sensitive coordination.
checkOutcomes.reason: The site shows local Venezuelan daily draw schedules and dates, with no cross-time-zone events, user-entered times, or DST-sensitive coordination.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual review of public landing, results, detail, and help pages
checkOutcomes.evidence: No confirmshaming, forced consent, preselected purchase, disguised control, or forced-continuity flow appeared on the audited public pages.
The audited public flow has only a date selector and no required multi-field form or validation-error flow to exercise.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited public flow has only a date selector and no required multi-field form or validation-error flow to exercise.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The only public input sampled is a date/results selector; address, payment, sign-in, and sign-up autofill assistance is not applicable on these pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: The only public input sampled is a date/results selector; address, payment, sign-in, and sign-up autofill assistance is not applicable on these pages.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, consent, or account-management flow exists on the audited public origin; login/register lead to a separate secure subdomain.
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription, consent, or account-management flow exists on the audited public origin; login/register lead to a separate secure subdomain.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Images are predominantly WebP, but 100 result images omit dimensions, 74 omit responsive sources, and 88 below-fold images load eagerly.
The page eagerly fetches 173 images and ships largely unused Bootstrap, icon, and DataTables code despite a light main thread.
Nine third-party requests transfer 213,552 bytes; Google Tag Manager alone transfers 179,180 bytes and multiple advertising/analytics origins run on load.

checkOutcomes.method: WebMCP/markup inspection and contextual applicability judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: This public results-content site exposes no transactional agent capability that needs WebMCP; raw content is already machine-readable, while robots policy explicitly limits major AI crawlers.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public results-content site exposes no transactional agent capability that needs WebMCP; raw content is already machine-readable, while robots policy explicitly limits major AI crawlers.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, generation, or language task on this simple results site warrants on-device inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation, generation, or language task on this simple results site warrants on-device inference.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline/post heap snapshots around ten menu open/close cycles
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten menu cycles, heap self size rose from 12,337,567 to 12,648,725 bytes (2.5%) rather than showing unbounded growth; live DOM remained stable.
The sampled server-rendered page used about 12.3–12.6 MB heap self size with 978 live elements, proportionate to its long content page.

checkOutcomes.method: Instrumented repeated-interaction probe plus heap comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: Ten menu cycles left the live DOM at 978 nodes, created no intervals, and added only three transitionend listeners total rather than accumulating per cycle.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to this site and its representative public tasks.

paths.description: Homepage and category gateway; represents first impression, navigation and category choice.
Animalitos results listing; represents the highest-density primary results task and date-selection flow.
Lotto Activo detail; represents informational lottery/detail templates.
Help and FAQ; represents disclosure interaction and support content.
Invalid URL; represents HTTP/network failure recovery.

findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark the body remains white, color-scheme is normal, and the screenshot is identical to light mode.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and define tested dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.evidence: The site has multiple document routes but the CSS probe found no View Transition styling or names.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } for same-origin MPA navigation, then name stable shared elements and respect reduced motion.

findings.summary: The long results template is visually noisy and hard to orient within
findings.evidence: The mobile results page is 22,963 CSS px tall and surrounds results with ads, a fixed logo rail, repeated social links, and no progress/current-section cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove non-actionable repeated chrome, lazy-render result sections, and add a lightweight section/progress affordance for the long page.

findings.summary: FAQ disclosure state is not semantic or reliable
findings.evidence: No details elements exist, and after opening one FAQ all sampled question buttons expose aria-expanded=true.
findings.suggestedFix: Use details/summary for each FAQ, or correctly pair each button with one controlled region and update aria-expanded only for that item.

findings.summary: Keyboard and touch affordances are weak
findings.evidence: Focus probing found outline:none on many links, result controls are 38 px high, and the page contains hundreds of unnamed hash links in the tab order.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible ring, make primary targets at least 44 CSS px where practical, and remove or name non-functional icon links.

findings.summary: Image sizing causes poor visual stability
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured CLS 0.265; 100/100 result images and 33/33 home images omit width and height.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and reserve ad/result media space before loading.

findings.summary: The results page eagerly ships excessive assets and unused code
findings.evidence: HAR records 205 requests and 1.52 MB transferred, including 173 images; 88 below-fold images are eager. Lighthouse estimates 85 KiB unused JS and 37 KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold images, add responsive sources, render result groups on demand/content-visibility, and remove page-inapplicable DataTables/icon/Bootstrap code.

findings.summary: Core text and buttons fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 2.95:1 for teal primary buttons, 2.47:1 for Register, and 2.8:1 for the teal H1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken teal/orange tokens or switch foreground colors so normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text/UI reaches its required ratio in every state.

findings.summary: Result imagery and controls lack accessible names and structure
findings.evidence: All 100 result images lack alt, 310 links have empty text, the date input lacks a label, and heading order skips levels.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful result images concise alt text, decorative images alt="", label the date field, remove empty links, and restore a sequential heading hierarchy.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache blockers caused by cache-control:no-store on the document and fetched resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Use private/no-cache with validators where fresh data is required instead of blanket no-store, and reserve no-store for genuinely sensitive responses.

findings.summary: Search and sharing metadata is malformed and keyword-stuffed
findings.evidence: The result title is 1,073 characters, canonical and JSON-LD are absent, sitemap.xml is 404, and og:url/og:image use malformed https:/ URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate concise unique titles/descriptions, valid canonical and Open Graph URLs, a sitemap, and accurate Lottery/Organization/Breadcrumb structured data where supported.

findings.summary: HTTP failures provide no recovery path
findings.evidence: A missing URL renders only Apache’s “Not Found” text with no site shell, home link, search, or useful next action.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 in the normal shell with a clear explanation and links to current results, home, and help.

findings.summary: Baseline browser defenses and session-cookie flags are missing
findings.evidence: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; PHPSESSID lacks Secure, HttpOnly and restrictive SameSite.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax/Strict on PHPSESSID; deploy HSTS, nosniff, a restrictive CSP, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy after testing.

findings.summary: Tracking runs broadly on load with long-lived identifiers
findings.evidence: Seven third-party origins include Analytics and DoubleClick; analytics cookies persist 400 days and third parties transfer 213,552 bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Document consent/legal basis, defer non-essential analytics/ads until appropriate consent, shorten retention, and remove tags that do not provide measured value.

taskList.title: Repair accessible names, labels, heading order, focus, targets, and color contrast
Reserve image space and defer/trim the long results payload
Replace keyword stuffing with valid canonical, sitemap, Open Graph, and structured metadata
Reduce and consent-gate advertising and analytics tracking
Simplify and orient the long results page
Make FAQ disclosure semantic and state-correct
Add a useful branded 404 recovery page
Restore BFCache eligibility where responses are not sensitive
